title: Fee schedule version register
description: All schedule versions with FeeBase contract, effective dates, approvers and cost basis reference.

title: Fee run record
description: Per run: inputs, computed bases, rates, results, recomputation comparison and postings.

title: Fee calculation explanation for donors
description: Donor-facing breakdown of each fee charged (base, rate, days, schedule version).

title: Fee change approval record
description: Proposed and approved schedule diffs, conflict check results, approvers and notice evidence.

title: Fee shortfall memo claim register
description: Open fee shortfalls per fund with waiver or write-off decisions.

title: Contribution component breakdown
description: Per contribution: gross, covered fee, non-charity amounts, credited amount and acknowledgment amount.

title: Related-party check log
description: Per payment or accrual: payee match result against related-party registry and rule reference.

title: Echelon related-party and compensation disclosure
description: Statement of Echelon relationships and compensation arrangements with the sponsor and partners.

title: Independent recomputation of fees and SOC 1 testing of fee change control
description: Agreed-upon procedures or SOC 1 Type 2 control testing by an independent CPA: recomputation of a sample of fund-level fees from versioned schedules and testing of fee schedule change control.
format: Report or letter (PDF) with scope, period and issuer
notes: Fix pass 2026-11-25 (fix-pass-agent): created for BL-021. Covers all fee answer units.
